name: A reversing economic event matches its original's quantity, measure, and action

payload.rationale: 1-hop LAW-LINK-1 reversal parity: a linked reversal matches the quantity, unit, currency, and action of the posted event it reverses (same-resource / per-account cancellation remains enforced by the kernel reversal primitive).

response.expression: self.quantity == self.reverses.quantity and ((self.unit == null) == (self.reverses.unit == null)) and ((self.unit ?? '') == (self.reverses.unit ?? '')) and ((self.currency == null) == (self.reverses.currency == null)) and ((self.currency ?? '') == (self.reverses.currency ?? '')) and self.action == self.reverses.action

payload.subject: core.EconomicEvent
